_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: A link to a conversation keeps the page loading until that conversation shows, even when the live stream delivers the conversation list first. The conversation at /c/deep-link exists; the server holds the page's first load of the conversation list (GET /api/conversations/snapshot) until the call "release". Calls: "snapshot requested" returns "true" once that request has arrived ("false" before). window.__listPatches counts the conversation list updates the page's live stream has delivered. "The message input" is [data-testid="message-input"]; "the loading screen" is ".loading-container". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/deep-link. 2. Call "snapshot requested" until it returns "true". 3. Eval window.__listPatches > 0 until it returns true: the stream has delivered the list while the first load is held. 4. Two frames later the page must still be loading, with no composer: eval new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => r(!!document.querySelector('.loading-container') + ' ' + !!document.querySelector('[data-testid="message-input"]'))))) with expect "true false". 5. Call "release". 6. The message input should become visible, and the URL must be exactly /c/deep-link. 7. Fill the message input with "Follow-up": the button [data-testid="send-button"] should be enabled.
